source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Select the Test records - Summaries or any other view that consists of a single-item-per-row for each test.
3. Create a new filter for 'Passed' (column name column_A) where the values for the filter are the symbol $\square$ or the text 'No'. In this instance the column has two values: \[\] (a box) for PASS and \[X\] for FAIL. "Passed?" = \[\] Only the failures remain now.
4. Mark all the records.
5. Click "Send email notification" from the "Bulk actions" menu.
6. Paste the text below into the "Message body"
7. Delete any columns you do not require.*
8. Optionally, replace the headings as you wish.
9. Click "OK"

This procedure was used in Firefox 59.0.3 (64-bit) on MacOS Sierra 10
